about_the_game:
Chetta: The Machinery Girl DEMO
[Scope of the Demo Version]
You can play the event at the beginning of the story (approx. 20 min.) and explore the initial part of the forest area. (You cannot progress in the main story.) You can collect and craft items, learn skills, and upgrade weapons in the demo version.
A message that the demo version is over will appear at a reasonable stopping point.

Stranded on a mysterious, uncharted island, Chetta, a young girl with no memory of how she arrived, must fight to survive. The island is filled with dangerous creatures, hostile natives, and her pursuers, all of whom are coming after her, in more ways than one… With only her wits, she must scavenge, craft, and battle her way through the treacherous wilderness. Come join us and play the demo version of Chetta: The Machinery Girl, an Action-Adventure, survival RPG game!

Chetta (VA: Fuyusa Nagi)

The main character. She was seemingly famed for being a girl genius, but she's currently lost her memory. She was pursued for being a rebel and crash-landed on an undeveloped island. She's cheerful, positive, and not one to let hardship get her down, but it's unclear if this was always her personality.

Lina (Ryoko Tezuka)

The captain of the squadron pursuing Chetta. Her impulsivity sometimes creates trouble for the people around her. She seems to have had a deep relationship with Chetta in the past, but Chetta doesn't remember it.

Rabbit

The support AI for the MK-L that Chetta pilots. It teaches the amnesiac Chetta various things.

**These features are also available in the demo

  • Tons of horny enemies!

    Everyone's out to get Chetta! Either skillfully defeat your opponents in battle, or risk letting them have their way with her.

  • Gorgeous graphics!

    High-quality animations that mix 3D CG and LIVE 2D graphics! All parts of Chetta's body move, giggle, and bounce!

  • Level up through exploration!

    Use skill points to get stronger!

  • Learn new recipes for crafting battle items as you win fights!

    You'll come up with stronger items as you refine your skills!

  • Gears attached to your weapons will improve at random!

    Use your favorite weapons until you master them!

  • Difficulty adjustments that allow you to turn various elements on and off!

    You can play casually and focus on the story, or you can turn up the difficulty to enjoy challenging exploration and combat! It's all up to you!

Explore the map, craft materials, battle monsters and enemies while you help Chetta recover her memories.

💠💠
This game was developed using a tool called RPGDeveloperBakin.

Compared to games developed using RPG Maker, this game requires higher PC specs.

We recommend playing the demo to check how well the game runs on your PC before considering the purchase of the full version.

*We received feedback from players who reported issues running the game even when their PCs met the minimum specs we listed in the past, so we have changed the minimum specs to match the minimum specs for RPGDeveloperBakin. We appreciate your understanding.

*AMD CPUs (Ryzen) and GPUs (Radeon) may result in errors such as the graphics in animated segments being displayed incorrectly.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains content that is not suitable for all ages. It features nudity, sex scenes, as well as scenes that can be interpreted as non-consensual sex. If you are uncomfortable with this content, or are in a region where adult content is prohibited, do not play this game.

short_description: Chetta, an amnesiac girl, awakens and is forced to pilot a giant robot. Pursued for reasons she doesn't comprehend, Chetta crash-lands on an island filled with dangerous creatures, hostile native people, and her pursuers. Can Chetta escape the island unharmed? Her fate is left to the player…
